title: Lesson 10
paragraph: 設計の確認と信頼できる設備

words.meaning: a condition or capability that a product or system must satisfy
words.example: One requirement is that the device must operate outdoors.

words.meaning: a limit that restricts the choices available when designing a system
words.example: The available space is a constraint on the new design.

words.meaning: the use of a model to imitate a system's behavior under chosen conditions
words.example: The simulation predicts how the structure responds to wind.

words.meaning: checking that a system meets users' needs in its intended use
words.japaneseMeaning: 妥当性確認・用途への適合確認
words.example: Validation included trials with the people who would use the equipment.
words.usageNote: ここでは用途への適合確認です。verification は定められた要求事項への適合を確認します。

words.meaning: checking that a system or product meets its stated requirements
words.japaneseMeaning: 検証・要求事項への適合確認
words.example: Verification confirmed that the housing met the specified dimensions.

words.meaning: the ability of equipment to perform its required function under stated conditions for a period of time
words.example: The long test assessed the reliability of the pump.

words.meaning: extra components or functions provided so a system can continue if one fails
words.japaneseMeaning: 冗長性・予備機能の用意
words.example: Redundancy allows the second power unit to take over if the first stops.

sentencePractice.prompt: The system has a spare power unit that takes over if the first unit fails. Providing this extra unit is an example of ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: An additional unit that maintains function after a failure provides redundancy; comparison with a reference and use of a model do not describe the design feature.

words.meaning: a particular way in which a component or system can stop performing its required function
words.example: A stuck valve is one possible failure mode.

words.meaning: an underlying reason that explains why a failure or problem occurred
words.example: The investigation traced the root cause to an incorrect assembly step.

sentencePractice.prompt: The investigation asks why the valve failed and finds that a wrongly fitted part caused the problem. That underlying reason is the ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: The underlying reason is the root cause; failure mode describes how the valve fails and setpoint is a control target, not an explanation of the failure.

words.meaning: the process of identifying possible harm and judging its likelihood and consequences
words.example: The team completed a risk assessment before the trial.
